headline: 2007 order lets the U.S. freeze the property of people seen as threatening efforts to stabilize Iraq.
what_it_does: This executive order allows the U.S. government to block, or freeze, property and assets under U.S. control that belong to certain people found to threaten stabilization efforts in Iraq. Blocked property generally cannot be moved, sold, or used. The title does not say exactly who qualifies or how they are chosen, so details beyond the title are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups named as threatening stabilization in Iraq
who_it_affects.how: Their property and assets under U.S. control can be frozen.
They would generally be expected to stop dealing with property belonging to people named under the order.
